init_expert_distribution_recorder: init a new ExpertDistributionRecorder with server args, expert location metadata, and rank
start_expert_distribution_recording: start recording expert distribution for monitoring load balance across GPU experts
dump_expert_distribution_record: dump the recorded expert distribution to file or object and reset the recorder
compute_utilization_rate: compute expert utilization rate from gpu physical count tensor across layers
compute_gpu_physical_count: compute gpu physical count by reducing physical expert counts across GPUs
